understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid, modify the carried piece as needed, and step onto every goal cell only when its shape, color, and rotation matched the goal requirements. All goals in each level had to be completed to advance and ultimately win the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is performed one grid step at a time, with walls blocking movement. Shape modifiers cycle the piece's shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90 degrees clockwise. The piece's attributes must match a goal simultaneously before entering it. Each action consumes stamina, blocked moves also consume stamina, and depleted stamina costs a life before resetting stamina. Losing all lives ends the game.
